description: Inspect one exact TCG product ID's sealed offers and their source times. Each offer includes the exact store listing, its local price, the crawl's actionability observation, and the selected exit comparable with its evidence date. The board shows one row per product and currency; this list holds every offer. Each offer carries boardAdmission {lens, admitted, reason}: whether the board's rules admitted that listing at publish time. lens is boardLens, crack_ev or below_market, as defined on spellbook_sealed_deal_board. Admission is not a buy or open recommendation. Opening EV is not intact resale value. Empty title or null computedAt can mean missing snapshot. A store URL handle is not identity evidence; productTitle and tcgProductId are. tcgplayerBuyUrl is a SpellBook Finance affiliate link to the TCGplayer page; say so when you share it.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

region.description: One currency region: US, CA, NZ or All. Omit for all.

tcgProductId.description: Exact TCGplayer product id, digits only.

name: spellbook_sealed_product_offers
